title: MedFeat: Model-Aware and Explainability-Driven Feature Engineering with LLMs for Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2603.02221v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In clinical tabular prediction, classical machine learning models with feature engineering often outperform neural methods. LLMs are increasingly used to automate this process, acting as domain experts that propose diverse feature transformations to boost downstream performance. However, the feature generation process of existing LLM-based methods is agnostic to the downstream learner: the LLM receives no signal about which features currently drive predictions or where the model's representational capacity falls short, so proposals are neither targeted to promising regions of the feature space nor tailored to the learner's inductive bias. This shortcoming is amplified in healthcare data, which simultaneously exhibits class imbalance, heterogeneous feature spaces, and strict interpretability requirements. translated_title: MedFeat：基于大语言模型的模型感知与可解释性驱动的表格预测特征工程
translated_abstract: 在临床表格预测中，结合特征工程的经典机器学习模型往往优于神经网络方法。大语言模型正被越来越多地用于自动化这一过程，充当领域专家的角色，提出多样化的特征变换以提升下游性能。然而，现有基于大语言模型方法的特征生成过程对下游学习器是无感知的：大语言模型接收不到任何关于哪些特征正在驱动预测、或模型表示能力在何处不足的信号，因此其生成的提案既不针对特征空间中有前景的区域，也不适配学习器的归纳偏置。这一缺陷在医疗健康数据中被进一步放大，因为此类数据同时存在类别不平衡、异构特征空间以及严格的可解释性要求。在本文中，我们提出了 MedFeat，首个受机器学习实践者工作流程启发的特征工程框架（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: MedFeat 是首个模型感知且由可解释性驱动的大语言模型特征工程框架，通过向 LLM 反馈哪些特征在驱动预测以及模型表示能力的不足之处，来生成针对下游学习器的临床表格数据特征，从而提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: MedFeat is the first model-aware and explainability-driven LLM-based feature engineering framework for clinical tabular prediction, which guides feature generation by feeding back signals about which features drive predictions and where the downstream model's representational capacity falls short.
